valuation.method: Forward Core EPS x P/E (FY2027E Core EPS viewed at the 12-month target date). Ordinary-share JPY figures are converted to TAK ADR (USD) using the 1 ADR = 0.5 ordinary share ratio (2 ADRs = 1 ordinary share) and the 2026-11-13 USD/JPY close of 159.90.

bear.driver: Generic erosion (e.g., Vyvanse) and slower new-launch ramp weigh on CER revenue and margins
bear.assumption: Core EPS $1.40 per ADR at 13.0x P/E

base.driver: FY2026 Core EPS guidance (JPY 482/share = $1.51/ADR) grows ~6% in FY2027 on Orzeyful/Mimrylo launches and cost discipline
base.assumption: Core EPS $1.60 per ADR at 14.5x P/E

bull.driver: Faster commercial uptake of Orzeyful and Mimrylo plus operating leverage from restructuring
bull.assumption: Core EPS $1.80 per ADR at 16.0x P/E

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E Core EPS ($1.60/ADR), the $21.43 close implies 13.4x forward P/E (and 14.2x FY2026 guidance of $1.51/ADR).
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $1.60 (7.5 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Constant-exchange-rate (CER) revenue growth and commercial ramp of Orzeyful and Mimrylo
valuation.next_disclosure: Q3 FY2026 earnings release scheduled for 2027-01-28

analyst_notes: Individual dated analyst calls with verifiable issue timestamps were not captured in this run, so coverage is marked unavailable for weighted calculation. Broad Street consensus leans Buy/Moderate Buy with average 12-month ADR targets clustered around $21.86-$24.65 (roughly +2% to +15% above the $21.43 close), broadly aligned with our $23.20 (+8.3%) base case.
